* `--rerun-fails` now reruns only the failed subtest (instead of the entire root test), by running each test individually instead of the failed tests in a package.

name: v0.5.0
body:
## New Features

- [Post run command](https://github.com/gotestyourself/gotestsum/tree/v0.5.0#post-run-command) - may be used for desktop notification
- [Re-running failed tests](https://github.com/gotestyourself/gotestsum/tree/v0.5.0#re-running-failed-tests) - to save time when dealing with flaky test suites
- [Finding and skipping slow tests](https://github.com/gotestyourself/gotestsum/tree/v0.5.0#finding-and-skipping-slow-tests) - using `gotestsum tool slowest`

## Bug fixes

- when the same test case appears multiple times in the input (possibly because of `-count=n`) the output of each will be preserved. Previously only the last test case output was saved.
- fixed a bug where the output of a skipped sub-test would be lost
